title: Managed Database: promotion discount
content:
## Tier basis
Managed Database promotion discount is specified by contracted tier. Discount fraction for a recorded eligible campaign on primary usage; decimal. Channels eligible for campaign pricing; string list.

| Contracted tier | Promotion discount | Promotion channels |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore | 0.05 | portal; API |
| Northbridge Managed Database 4 vCore | 0.05 | portal; API |
| Northbridge Managed Database 8 vCore | 0.05 | portal; API |
| Northbridge Managed Database 16 vCore | 0.05 | portal; API |
| Northbridge Managed Database 32 vCore | 0.05 | portal; API |
| Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore | 0.05 | portal; API |

## Tier comparison
For promotion discount, Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore and Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore use the same declared value of 0.05.
